license_required.quote: No person may engage in the electrical construction trade without having a valid master journey level electrician certificate of competency, journey level electrician certificate of competency, master specialty electrician certificate of competency, or specialty electrician certificate of competency issued by the department in accordance with this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: "Department" means the department of labor and industries.

name.quote: "Department" means the department of labor and industries.

type.quote: The director of labor and industries of the state of Washington and the officials of all incorporated cities and towns where electrical inspections are required by local ordinances shall have power and it shall be their duty to enforce the provisions of this chapter in their respective jurisdictions.

degree_required.value: Approved classroom training covering this chapter, the national electrical code, or electrical theory; or equivalent classroom training taken as part of an approved apprenticeship program
degree_required.quote: proof of forty-eight hours of: Approved classroom training covering this chapter, the national electrical code, or electrical theory; or equivalent classroom training taken as part of an approved apprenticeship program under chapter 49.04 RCW or an approved electrical training program under RCW 19.28.191(1)(e)

degree_level.quote: proof of forty-eight hours of: Approved classroom training covering this chapter, the national electrical code, or electrical theory; or equivalent classroom training taken as part of an approved apprenticeship program under chapter 49.04 RCW

school_approval_basis.quote: The contents and requirements for satisfactory completion of the continuing education course must be determined by the director and approved by the board.

credential_pegged.quote: No person may engage in the electrical construction trade without having a valid master journey level electrician certificate of competency, journey level electrician certificate of competency, master specialty electrician certificate of competency, or specialty electrician certificate of competency issued by the department

required.quote: To be eligible to take the examination for a journey level certificate of competency, the applicant must have: Successfully completed the work experience and education requirements of an 8,000 hour electrical construction trade apprenticeship program approved under chapter 49.04 RCW.

experience_source.quote: Successfully completed the work experience and education requirements of an 8,000 hour electrical construction trade apprenticeship program approved under chapter 49.04 RCW. Four thousand of the hours must be new industrial or commercial electrical installations

duration.value: 8,000 hours (journey level); 4,000 hours (specialty electrician for most specialties)
duration.quote: Successfully completed the work experience and education requirements of an 8,000 hour electrical construction trade apprenticeship program approved under chapter 49.04 RCW

kind.value: electrical construction trade apprenticeship or supervised work experience
kind.quote: Successfully completed the work experience and education requirements of an 8,000 hour electrical construction trade apprenticeship program approved under chapter 49.04 RCW

exams.name: Journey Level Electrician Certificate of Competency Examination
exams.notes: Administered at least four times annually; no limit on number of attempts.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Department of Labor and Industries, may contract with professional testing agency)
exams.quote: The department must, at least four times annually, administer the examination to persons eligible to take it under RCW 19.28.191.

exams.name: Master Journey Level Electrician Certificate of Competency Examination
exams.notes: Applicant must have held valid journey level certificate for four years. No limit on attempts.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Department of Labor and Industries, may contract with professional testing agency)
exams.quote: A person may take the master electrician examination as many times as necessary without limit.

exams.name: Specialty Electrician Certificate of Competency Examination
exams.notes: No limit on number of attempts.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Department of Labor and Industries, may contract with professional testing agency)
exams.quote: A person may take the examination as many times as necessary without limit.

exams.name: General/Specialty Electrical Administrator's Certificate Examination
exams.notes: Required for electrical contractor administrator designation. No limit on attempts.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Department of Labor and Industries/board, may contract with professional testing agency)
exams.quote: it shall be the purpose and function of the board to establish and administer written examinations for general electrical administrators' certificates and the various specialty electrical administrators' certificates.

interval_years.quote: The certificate shall be renewed every three years, upon application, on or before the holder's birthdate.

required.quote: If the certificate holder demonstrates to the department that he or she has satisfactorily completed an annual eight-hour continuing education course, the certificate may be renewed without examination by appropriate application

hours_per_period.quote: satisfactorily completed an annual eight-hour continuing education course

period_years.quote: satisfactorily completed an annual eight-hour continuing education course

available.quote: The department is authorized to enter into reciprocal agreements with other states providing for the acceptance of such states' journey level and specialty electrician certificate of competency or its equivalent when such states requirements are equal to the standards set by this chapter.

requirements.value: Reciprocal agreements with other states whose requirements are equal to Washington standards; out-of-state applicants must provide evidence of equivalent qualifications and may receive a temporary permit while awaiting examination results.
requirements.quote: An electrician from another jurisdiction applying for a certificate of competency must provide evidence in a form prescribed by the department affirming that the person has the equivalent qualifications to those required under RCW 19.28.191.

exists.quote: There is hereby created an electrical board, consisting of fifteen members to be appointed by the governor with the advice of the director of labor and industries as herein provided.

regulatory_model.quote: No person may engage in the electrical construction trade without having a valid master journey level electrician certificate of competency, journey level electrician certificate of competency, master specialty electrician certificate of competency, or specialty electrician certificate of competency issued by the department in accordance with this chapter.

credential_type.quote: The department shall issue a certificate of competency to all applicants who have passed the examination provided in RCW 19.28.201, met the in-class education requirements of RCW 19.28.205 if applicable, and who have complied with RCW 19.28.161 through 19.28.271 and the rules adopted under this chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: It is unlawful for any individual to engage in the electrical construction trade or to maintain or install any electrical equipment or conductors without having in his or her possession a certificate of competency, a temporary permit, or a training certificate under RCW 19.28.161 through 19.28.271, and photo identification.

title_protection.quote: "Journey level electrician" means a person who has been issued a journey level electrician certificate of competency by the department.

scope_protection.quote: No person may engage in the electrical construction trade without having a valid master journey level electrician certificate of competency, journey level electrician certificate of competency, master specialty electrician certificate of competency, or specialty electrician certificate of competency issued by the department in accordance with this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: The certificate was obtained through error or fraud.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The certificate was obtained through error or fraud;

disciplinary_grounds.description: The holder is judged to be incompetent to work in the electrical construction trade as a journey level electrician or specialty electrician.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The holder thereof is judged to be incompetent to work in the electrical construction trade as a journey level electrician or specialty electrician;

disciplinary_grounds.description: The holder has violated any of the provisions of RCW 19.28.161 through 19.28.271 or any rule adopted under this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The holder thereof has violated any of the provisions of RCW 19.28.161 through 19.28.271 or any rule adopted under this chapter;

disciplinary_grounds.description: The holder has committed a serious violation of this chapter or any rule adopted under this chapter that presents imminent danger to the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The holder thereof has committed a serious violation of this chapter or any rule adopted under this chapter. A serious violation is a violation that presents imminent danger to the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: The department shall immediately suspend the certificate of a person certified by DSHS as not in compliance with a support order.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The department shall immediately suspend the license or certificate of a person who has been certified pursuant to RCW 74.20A.320 by the department of social and health services as a person who is not in compliance with a support order.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Serious noncompliance with the provisions of this chapter may result in revocation or suspension of an electrical contractor license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The department has the power, in case of serious noncompliance with the provisions of this chapter, to revoke or suspend for such a period as it determines, any electrical or telecommunications contractor license or electrical or telecommunications contractor administrator certificate issued under this chapter.

bonding_required.quote: The application for an electrical contractor license shall be accompanied by a bond in the sum of four thousand dollars with the state of Washington named as obligee in the bond, with good and sufficient surety, to be approved by the department.

insurance_required.quote: At the time of licensing and subsequent relicensing, the applicant shall furnish insurance or financial responsibility in the form of an assigned account in the amount of twenty thousand dollars for injury or damages to property, fifty thousand dollars for injury or damage including death to any one person, and one hundred thousand dollars for injury or damage including death to more than one person, or financial responsibility to satisfy these amounts.

definition_quote.value: "Electrical construction trade" includes, but is not limited to, installing or maintaining electrical wires and equipment that are used for light, heat, or power and installing and maintaining remote control, signaling, power limited, or communication circuits or systems.
definition_quote.quote: "Electrical construction trade" includes, but is not limited to, installing or maintaining electrical wires and equipment that are used for light, heat, or power and installing and maintaining remote control, signaling, power limited, or communication circuits or systems.

value: installing electrical wires and equipment for light, heat, or power
maintaining electrical wires and equipment for light, heat, or power
installing remote control, signaling, power limited, or communication circuits or systems
maintaining remote control, signaling, power limited, or communication circuits or systems
methods_authorized.quote: "Electrical construction trade" includes, but is not limited to, installing or maintaining electrical wires and equipment that are used for light, heat, or power and installing and maintaining remote control, signaling, power limited, or communication circuits or systems.

license_tiers.quote: No person may engage in the electrical construction trade without having a valid master journey level electrician certificate of competency, journey level electrician certificate of competency, master specialty electrician certificate of competency, or specialty electrician certificate of competency issued by the department in accordance with this chapter. Electrician certificate of competency specialties include, but are not limited to: Residential, pump and irrigation, limited energy system, signs, nonresidential maintenance, restricted nonresidential maintenance, and appliance repair.

value: Telephone, telegraph, radio, and television wires and equipment, and television antenna installations, signal strength amplifiers, and coaxial installations
Wires and equipment within section 90.2(b)(5) of the National Electrical Code (1981 edition)
Wires and equipment within the communication worker safety zone and supply space on poles supporting electric utility transmission or distribution lines
Electric utility-owned equipment between a meter base and meter
Ignition or lighting systems for motor vehicles
Work by utilities on their own lines and equipment
Medical devices compliant with the Medical Device Amendments of 1976
Manufacturer's industrial equipment maintenance/repair by authorized engineers and factory-trained technicians (low voltage digital control system connections)
scope_exclusions.quote: The following are exempt from the requirements of this chapter: All wires and equipment that fall within section 90.2(b)(5) of the National Electrical Code, 1981 edition; all wires and equipment within the communication worker safety zone and supply space, as defined in the National Electrical Safety Code, on poles supporting electric utility transmission or distribution lines or wires; and electric utility-owned equipment between a meter base and meter.

minor_electrical_work_amperage_limit.quote: Extension of not more than one branch electrical circuit limited to one hundred twenty volts and twenty amps each

apprentice_supervision_ratio.value: Not more than one noncertified individual for every certified master journey level electrician or journey level electrician (journey level work); not more than two noncertified individuals for every certified master specialty electrician or specialty electrician (specialty work)
apprentice_supervision_ratio.quote: When working as a journey level electrician, not more than one noncertified individual for every certified master journey level electrician or journey level electrician

qualifier_required.quote: To obtain a general or specialty electrical contractor license, the applicant must designate an individual who currently possesses a valid master journey level electrician's certificate of competency, master specialty electrician's certificate of competency in the specialty for which application has been made, or administrator's certificate as a general electrical contractor administrator or as a specialty electrical contractor administrator in the specialty for which application has been made.

value: General electrical contractor: must designate individual with valid master journey level electrician's certificate of competency or general electrical contractor administrator's certificate

Specialty electrical contractor: must designate individual with valid master specialty electrician's certificate of competency in the applicable specialty or specialty electrical contractor administrator's certificate in the applicable specialty
qualifier_license_requirement_by_contrac.quote: To obtain a general or specialty electrical contractor license, the applicant must designate an individual who currently possesses a valid master journey level electrician's certificate of competency, master specialty electrician's certificate of competency in the specialty for which application has been made, or administrator's certificate as a general electrical contractor administrator or as a specialty electrical contractor administrator in the specialty for which application has been made.

qualifier_replacement_notice_days.quote: The contractor must notify the department in writing within ten days if the master electrician's or administrator's relationship with the contractor terminates due to the master electrician's or administrator's death or incapacitation.

qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.quote: If the relationship of the master electrician or administrator with the electrical contractor is terminated, the contractor's license is void within ninety days unless another master electrician or administrator is qualified by the board.

journeyman_electrician_apprenticeship_ho.quote: Successfully completed the work experience and education requirements of an 8,000 hour electrical construction trade apprenticeship program approved under chapter 49.04 RCW.

master_electrician_journeyman_experience.quote: To be eligible to take the examination for a master journey level electrician certificate of competency, the applicant must have possessed a valid journey level electrician certificate of competency for four years.

residential_master_electrician_journeyma.quote: To be eligible to take the examination for a master specialty electrician certificate of competency, the applicant must have possessed a valid specialty electrician certificate of competency, in the specialty applied for, for two years.

electrician_continuing_education_hours.quote: satisfactorily completed an annual eight-hour continuing education course

national_electrical_code_reference.quote: The regulations and articles in the National Electrical Code, the National Electrical Safety Code, and other installation and safety regulations approved by the national fire protection association, as modified or supplemented by rules issued by the department in furtherance of safety to life and property under authority hereby granted, shall be prima facie evidence of the approved methods of construction.

utility_worker_exemption.quote: No license under the provision of this chapter shall be required from any utility or any person, firm, partnership, corporation, or other entity employed by a utility because of work in connection with the installation, repair, or maintenance of lines, wires, apparatus, or equipment owned by or under the control of a utility

financial_responsibility_bond_option.quote: In lieu of the surety bond required by this section, the license applicant may file with the department a cash deposit or other negotiable security acceptable to the department.

workers_compensation_insurance_required.quote: Evidence of workers' compensation coverage for the applicant's employees working in Washington

public_liability_insurance_required.quote: At the time of licensing and subsequent relicensing, the applicant shall furnish insurance or financial responsibility in the form of an assigned account in the amount of twenty thousand dollars for injury or damages to property, fifty thousand dollars for injury or damage including death to any one person, and one hundred thousand dollars for injury or damage including death to more than one person
